name: 110 - Core - Prevent Replay and Duplicate Gateway Events - Corrected V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS clinic_id,
        $2::BIGINT AS client_id,
        $3::TEXT AS gateway_event_type,
        $4::TEXT AS channel,
        $5::TEXT AS external_event_id,
        NULLIF($6::TEXT, '') AS external_message_id,
        $7::TEXT AS request_hash,
        $8::TEXT AS replay_key,
        NULLIF($9::TEXT, '') AS source_ip,
        $10::TIMESTAMPTZ AS request_timestamp,
        $11::INTEGER AS replay_window_seconds
),

client_context AS (
    SELECT
        request.*,

        client.id AS registered_client_id,
        client.clinic_id AS registered_clinic_id,
        client.channel AS registered_channel,
        client.enabled AS client_enabled,

        CASE
            WHEN client.id IS NULL
                THEN FALSE
            ELSE TRUE
        END AS client_exists,

        CASE
            WHEN client.id IS NOT NULL
             AND client.clinic_id =
                 request.clinic_id
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS client_belongs_to_clinic,

        CASE
            WHEN client.id IS NOT NULL
             AND client.channel =
                 request.channel
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS channel_matches

    FROM request_data request
    LEFT JOIN channel_gateway_clients client
        ON client.id = request.client_id
),

freshness AS (
    SELECT
        context.*,

        CASE
            WHEN context.request_timestamp <
                 NOW() -
                 MAKE_INTERVAL(
                     secs =>
                       context.replay_window_seconds
                 )
                THEN FALSE

            WHEN context.request_timestamp >
                 NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
                THEN FALSE

            ELSE TRUE
        END AS timestamp_is_fresh

    FROM client_context context
),

inserted_request AS (
    INSERT INTO channel_gateway_requests (
        clinic_id,
        client_id,
        gateway_event_type,
        channel,
        external_event_id,
        external_message_id,
        request_hash,
        replay_key,
        source_ip,
        request_timestamp,
        authentication_status,
        rate_limit_status,
        processing_status
    )
    SELECT
        fresh.clinic_id,
        fresh.client_id,
        fresh.gateway_event_type,
        fresh.channel,
        fresh.external_event_id,
        fresh.external_message_id,
        fresh.request_hash,
        fresh.replay_key,
        fresh.source_ip,
        fresh.request_timestamp,
        'allowed',
        'allowed',
        'accepted'
    FROM freshness fresh
    WHERE fresh.client_exists = TRUE
      AND fresh.client_belongs_to_clinic = TRUE
      AND fresh.channel_matches = TRUE
      AND fresh.client_enabled = TRUE
      AND fresh.timestamp_is_fresh = TRUE
    ON CONFLICT (replay_key)
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING *
),

existing_request AS (
    SELECT request_row.*
    FROM channel_gateway_requests request_row
    INNER JOIN request_data request
        ON request_row.replay_key =
           request.replay_key
    LIMIT 1
),

selected_request AS (
    SELECT
        inserted.*,
        FALSE AS duplicate_event
    FROM inserted_request inserted

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        existing.*,
        TRUE AS duplicate_event
    FROM existing_request existing
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted_request
    )

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN freshness.client_exists = FALSE
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN freshness.client_belongs_to_clinic = FALSE
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN freshness.channel_matches = FALSE
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN freshness.client_enabled = FALSE
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN freshness.timestamp_is_fresh = FALSE
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN selected.duplicate_event = TRUE
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN selected.id IS NULL
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS allowed,

    CASE
        WHEN freshness.client_exists = FALSE
            THEN 'gateway_client_not_found'

        WHEN freshness.client_belongs_to_clinic = FALSE
            THEN 'gateway_client_clinic_mismatch'

        WHEN freshness.channel_matches = FALSE
            THEN 'gateway_client_channel_mismatch'

        WHEN freshness.client_enabled = FALSE
            THEN 'gateway_client_disabled'

        WHEN freshness.timestamp_is_fresh = FALSE
            THEN 'request_timestamp_outside_replay_window'

        WHEN selected.duplicate_event = TRUE
            THEN 'duplicate_gateway_event'

        WHEN selected.id IS NULL
            THEN 'gateway_request_not_registered'

        ELSE 'gateway_event_accepted'
    END AS result,

    selected.id AS gateway_request_id,

    COALESCE(
        selected.duplicate_event,
        FALSE
    ) AS duplicate_event,

    freshness.timestamp_is_fresh,
    freshness.replay_key,
    freshness.request_hash,

    freshness.client_exists,
    freshness.client_belongs_to_clinic,
    freshness.channel_matches,
    COALESCE(
        freshness.client_enabled,
        FALSE
    ) AS client_enabled,

    selected.received_at AS first_received_at

FROM freshness
LEFT JOIN selected_request selected
    ON TRUE;

parameters.content:
## Replay Protection — Corrected V2

قبل از INSERT این موارد بررسی می‌شوند:
- وجود Gateway Client
- تعلق Client به کلینیک
- تطابق کانال
- فعال‌بودن Client
- معتبر بودن Timestamp

در صورت نامعتبر بودن client_id، Workflow به‌جای خطای Foreign Key پاسخ gateway_client_not_found برمی‌گرداند.

برای تست دستی از شناسه‌ای استفاده کن که Workflow 112A در خروجی gateway_client.id برگردانده است.
